messages.subject: new NIMBLE website appearance
parts:
Hi all,

We've shifted our r-nimble.org website to be hosted via Quarto/GitHub Pages, in part because of a security issue with our previous hosting provider that caused the old WordPress site to be unavailable for a couple weeks.

It should have the same content and structure as the old site, but with a slightly different look.

Because we had to do this in a hurry, we're still doing some work on the structure and content (e.g., we still need to add some of the old blog posts and work on the math notation in the blog posts).

If you notice any problems with the website (or have suggestions), please let us know, either by filing a GitHub issue on the repository for the site or just by emailing me directly.

-Chris
